summary: A member gets a different committee assignment after helping elect a floor leader.
realLife: Shirley Chisholm endorsed Hale Boggs for majority leader. He helped her win a seat on Education and Labor while she was still serving on Veterans’ Affairs.
inGame: needs: a member's leadership vote linked to a committee assignment decision.

turns.what: The member backs the winning leader and stays on the old committee.
turns.pulledBy: Every seat on the requested panel is filled.
turns.writesBack: The assignment roster keeps the member on the old panel.

turns.what: The leader calls the member back when a panel vacancy opens.
turns.pulledBy: A member leaves the requested committee during the term.
